command: set -e; src=/code/website/static/public/js; dst=/wiki_static; ls "$src" >/dev/null; find "$dst" -mindepth 1 -delete; cp -a "$src"/. "$dst"/; if [ -f /code/webpack-assets.json ]; then cp -a /code/webpack-assets.json "$dst"/webpack-assets.json; fi; for f in "$dst"/wiki-edit-page.*.js; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cp -a "$f" "$dst"/wiki-edit-page.js; fi; done; ls -la "$dst"
note: One-shot (ADR-06): runs the wiki-frontend bundle-builder image grdm-dev/wiki-frontend:<osf_sha12>-<wiki_sha12> (osf.io tree + wiki-frontend files, built with the wiki-frontend Dockerfile, which only runs `yarn run webpack-prod`), copies its webpack output /code/website/static/public/js/ (entry wiki-edit-page -> wiki-edit-page.<chunkhash>.js, vendor.<hash>.js, source maps) and /code/webpack-assets.json into the named volume wiki_static, adds the unhashed alias wiki-edit-page.js, and exits. web/api/admin/worker mount wiki_static read-only at /code/website/static/public/js/wiki/ (a subpath: the osf.io image's own public/js keeps its ~40 bundles and its webpack-assets.json) and depend on this service with condition service_completed_successfully. Template wiring of /static/public/js/wiki/wiki-edit-page.js in osf.io is verified in the next real install run.
